description_en: Queries standard city data by keyword
description_zh: 根据关键字查找标准城市数据
name: StandardCitySearch

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query domestic or international cities. Valid values:

all: All cities. This is the default value.
domestic: Domestic cities.
international: International cities
parameters.help_zh: 查询国内还是国际 默认查询所有 all 国内：domestic 国际：international
parameters.name: search_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return. This parameter is optional. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is 10 (legacy behavior). For the open platform openSearch, the default value is 20 and the maximum value is 50
parameters.help_zh: 返回条数，可选；不传默认10条（存量行为）；开放平台 openSearch 不传默认20，最大50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The city region scope. This parameter is optional. Valid values:

all: No restriction. This is the default value.
chinese_mainland: The Chinese mainland.
outside_chinese_mainland: Outside the Chinese mainland, including Hong Kong (China), Macao (China), and Taiwan (China).

This parameter takes precedence over search_type when specified
parameters.help_zh: 城市范围，可选：all（不限，默认）/chinese_mainland（中国大陆）/outside_chinese_mainland（中国大陆以外，含港澳台）；传值时优先于 searchType
parameters.name: city_region

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access token.

When you call this operation over HTTP, this parameter is required and must be appended to the request URL. For more information about how to obtain the token, see Enterprise access token (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.5e2a281frQyDQ8&docId=3769985)
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。

通过 HTTP 方式调用本接口时，需要作为必填参数拼接在请求地址中。获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.5e2a281frQyDQ8&docId=3769985)
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token

province: Province.
city: City.
